style: instrumental video game menu theme, seamless 60 second loop. The character-select and company-founding screens of a hand-drawn startup satire game: choosing your founder on a spotlit stage, naming the company, splitting equity with cofounders. Mood: curious, bouncy, optimistic, a little cheeky — window-shopping your own destiny before signing anything. Marimba and intimate felt piano trade a light call-and-response; short soft trumpet fragments quote the main theme without stating it fully; round upright bass keeps a gentle bounce; brushed drums with finger snaps carry an easy groove; glockenspiel winks every eight bars; a quiet synth pluck adds modern air. Lighter and airier than a main theme — anticipation, not adventure. Small-room, dry, modern production with humanized timing. Structure: AABA with tiny ornament variations so it never tires. 96 BPM, F major. No vocals, no orchestra, no chiptune, no big cinematic moves, no intro, no outro, no fade-out.
